text.tspan: Conjecture (tested by a width scan, H21)
a network narrower than the latent
models W0, W4, W4s after training
potentials models: 2 to 3 times too many
Four remedies and two Gaussian baselines
exact Gaussian field + learned affine correction + network
G0: Gaussian law per mode (no covariance between modes), no network
Gaussian law with covariance between modes
G1: Gaussian law with the covariance between modes, no network
Two Gaussian laws without a network are closer to the reference than every learned model;
the one that keeps the covariance between modes (G1) is the best on all three columns.
